seed_data.title: SoundCalm architecture discussion
seed_data.body: Обсуждали с Тимой архитектуру аудио движка для SoundCalm. Решили использовать Core Audio вместо AVAudioEngine. Anya сделала дизайн нового онбординга. Жека задеплоил бэкенд на fly.io. Проблема с HealthKit — не получается синхронизировать данные сна в фоне. I prefer using async/await over Combine for the networking layer.

seed_data.title: PostgreSQL connection pooling decision
seed_data.body: We decided to use PgBouncer for connection pooling instead of built-in Rails pool. Under 200 concurrent connections, built-in pool was dropping connections. PgBouncer with transaction mode solved this. Config: max_client_conn=400, default_pool_size=20.

seed_data.title: JWT refresh token bug
seed_data.body: JWT refresh endpoint returning 401 with valid tokens. Root cause: kid header missing from refresh token JWT. Auth0 requires kid even though RFC 7515 says optional. Fix: added kid extraction from JWKS endpoint. Took 2 days to debug.

seed_data.title: Rekap LangGraph migration
